operator_question: Is the new engine strictly stronger? Did the new engine ever lose to the old engine?
milestone: M3 (the new engine outplays the old one) — the missing half: the new engine measured for the same fault T366 found in the old engine.

instrument.build_git_head: 19cd78b (detached worktree /tmp/weizigo/t375/wt; committed engine sources — the main tree's engine sources were mid-edit by T363)
instrument.note: The instrument's JSON header is hardcoded to the T366 task; this file relabels the header to T375. Game data passed through unchanged.

mirror_measurement.method: T366's instrument, roles swapped: at each of the NEW engine's decision points (its colour's turns beyond the opening) the OLD engine's move is substituted and the game replayed; classification decided by outcome with T366's four labels, inverted. Same openings (3 canonical one-ply + 30 seeded random two-ply, seed 42), same frames, same 66-per-frame denominator.

lh_check.method: The check the mirror cannot make (the old engine is a weak arbiter for the new one — it is the untrusted build). For each new-engine loss, read the new table's own stored L/H bracket at the FIRST-DIVERGENCE node (the node both engines evaluated, with the node's (ko, passes) key). If the bracket claims the position was won for the new engine's colour and the game was then lost, that is a self-contradiction of the kind T366 found in the old table (fA-o32-W: a value its own play could not reach). Bracket values are Black-positive; claim won-for-new == (new==B and L>0) or (new==W and H<0). Verdicts counted only on in-scope nodes (ko none, passes 0); out-of-scope nodes reported as data.
lh_check.report_dont_adapt: No self-contradiction found; no witness state recorded; nothing to stop for.

null_control.detail: Re-running T366's own direction (same seed 42, same 33 openings, both frames) reproduces T366's published figures exactly: fA 3 genuine losses / 66, fB 7 / 66, 10 genuine-loss game records (fA-o19-W, fA-o21-B, fA-o32-W, fB-o02-B, fB-o04-B, fB-o06-B, fB-o17-B, fB-o19-W, fB-o21-B, fB-o32-W). Game-by-game comparison against the committed findings/T366-engine-kifu.json (19cd78b): 6072 scalar fields, 0 mismatches (only the sgf path differs, by out-dir).

seeded_control.detail: Injected a deliberately bad move (a pass) for the new engine at one decision point (fA-o00-B, moves-index 1, the new engine's first White move) using a copy of the instrument with an injection flag (src/seedctl.zig, additive-only). The game flips W+16 -> B+3 and the mirror classifier catches it: mirror_classification equal_value -> genuine_loss (via the mirror-arbiter fallback: old engine self-play wins W+16 with the new colour). The injection is surgical: 65 of 66 frame-A games byte-identical, only the target changed. Harness null control (no injection) is byte-identical to the main run: 0 mismatches.
